title: Iron Rift FPS
description: A fast, style-ranked browser FPS. Hold the container port through 8 waves of wolf- and boar-masked mercenaries, Sentinel robots, robot hounds and Exo heavies, then break The Warden.

defaultCaptions.x: Survived 8 waves of Iron Rift FPS, a browser shooter against masked mercs, humanoid robots, exosuits and a boss mech. Can you break The Warden?
defaultCaptions.facebook: Iron Rift FPS is a fast, hyper-real first-person wave shooter that runs right in your browser. M4, M870, RPG-X and frags versus masked mercenaries, robot hounds, exosuits and The Warden.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Iron Rift FPS, a browser push-forward shooter with a style meter, augment picks between waves, and a boss fight against The Warden
defaultCaptions.discord: Iron Rift FPS. 8 waves, 1 Warden, S-rank or bust. Beat my score!
